# Services Agreement

This Services Agreement (this "Agreement") is made on Thursday, March 20, 2026 between Harbour Works Ltd (the "Supplier") and Northwind Retail Inc. (the "Customer").

## 1. Services

1.1 The Supplier shall provide the hosting and support services described in Schedule A (the "Services") to the Customer and its Affiliates.

1.2 The Supplier shall deliver a written monthly report on the Services (each, a "Report") to the Customer.

## 2. Fees

2.1 The Customer shall pay the Supplier a monthly fee of $9,000 for the services.

2.2 The monthly fee consists of $6,000 for hosting and $2,000 for support, for a total of $9,000.

2.3 The Vendor shall invoice the Customer at the end of each month, and the Customer shall pay each invoice promptly.

## 3. Term

This Agreement starts on Wednesday, April 1, 2026 and continues for a period of six (6) months, until March 31, 2027.

## 4. Confidentiality

4.1 Each party shall keep the other party's non-public business information disclosed under this Agreement ("Confidential Information") confidential and shall not disclose it to any third party.

4.2 Section 4.1 does not apply to disclosures to a subcontractor engaged under Section 9.

## 5. Subcontracting

Harbour Works Ltd may subcontract any part of the Services with the Customer's prior written consent, provided that the subcontractor is bound by obligations no less protective than those in Section 4 (Termination).

## 6. Termination

6.1 Either party may terminate this Agreement if the other party breaches it and fails to cure the breach within fourteen (14) days of receiving written notice of it.

6.2 On termination, the Supplier shall return all Confidential Information to the Customer within ten (10) days.

## 8. Governing Law

This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York.

Signed by the parties on the date first written above.

Harbour Works Ltd

Northwind Retail Inc.
